facts.text: I live only on the island of Borneo.
I spend most of my time high up in the trees.
My long arms can stretch about 2 meters wide!
Fruit is my favorite food, especially wild figs!
Every night I build a new bed of branches and leaves.
Grown-up boy orangutans grow big cheek pads.
A mom has a new baby only every 6 to 9 years.
Rescue groups help orangutans go back to the forest.

foods.caption: Yum! Fruit is my favorite food!
No thanks! Orangutans don't eat burgers.
No, thank you! I'd rather have a fig.

cards: My name means 'person of the forest' in Malay!
My fingers curl like hooks to hang on tight!
